risks.note: The Group operates across pharmaceutical formulations, APIs, diagnostics, analytical/laboratory instruments and broadcast equipment through 8 subsidiaries, 2 joint ventures and 1 associate, adding execution and capital-allocation complexity across dissimilar businesses.
risks.risk: Diversified conglomerate structure spanning unrelated businesses

risks.note: Asence continues to scale up its oncology and synthetic API manufacturing facility, but the Company states it continues to pursue various regulatory approvals and commercial opportunities for products made there, indicating revenue from this facility is not yet fully secured.
risks.risk: Commercial ramp-up at the Ranoli, Vadodara facility remains regulatory-approval dependent

risks.note: CoSara's product menu and manufacturing rights, including the upcoming PCR point-of-care device, rest on its partnership with and exclusive India manufacturing rights for Co-Diagnostics Inc., USA, creating partner/counterparty concentration.
risks.risk: CoSara Diagnostics' product pipeline depends on a single overseas partner

risks.note: The Directors regretted their inability to recommend payment of any dividend for the year, pointing to constraints on distributable cash or reinvestment priorities.
risks.risk: Inability to recommend a dividend despite a reported consolidated net profit

risks.note: The Company has multiple ongoing related-party dealings (sales, purchases, loans, guarantees and corporate guarantees) with its subsidiaries and joint ventures, creating financial interdependency across the group.
Vovantis Laboratories treats the USA as a key focus area with its plant USFDA-approved, so that JV's export prospects are tied to continued compliance with a single overseas regulator.
